title: Money, banking and monetary transmission
review_type: Specialist author accounting, mathematical, instructional and scoped primary-source review; root independently audits and alone accepts

reviewed.contract_and_prerequisites: Read current middle-batch production assignment, canonical c05/c06 specifications and STATUS; retained standing MASTER_PLAN and book/AGENTS conventions. Read relevant accepted c01 and c04 conventions for nominal versus physical accounting, financial claims versus production, exact real gross returns and dated credit/investment decisions. Drafted against c05 agreed prerequisite interface; root acceptance waits for c05. Sent early equations and full bank ledger to root and real-return notation to c07 author. Root independently confirmed early ledger, opportunity-cost and rate-model arithmetic before the full draft.
reviewed.money_and_units: Defined money functions, bank deposits, reserves, public currency, customer versus bank/central-bank asset-liability perspectives and explicit M/H aggregation boundaries. Distinguished money, credit and net worth, and card payment instructions from separate money balances. Defined positive dated prices, exact inflation factor and real balances in current goods. All synthetic figures have specified units, period conventions and non-empirical provenance; no October2026 policy rates or monetary observations are asserted.
reviewed.bounded_liquidity_choice: Derived future-real opportunity cost q=(i_b-i_m)/(1+pi) from both assets’ final purchasing-power payoffs, with fixed real wealth and known prices. Defined quadratic net convenience benefit in final-good equivalents, including handling costs. Proved unique global maximization by strict curvature and a completed square; treated both endpoints, equalities and zero wealth. Kept deposit/bill spread distinct from policy rate. Equal rate changes hold wealth/benefits/inflation fixed and use a linear future-wealth valuation; nominal price-level scaling also scales nominal wealth, avoiding an unintended real-wealth change. Exercise1 distinguishes interior point identification from a wealth-bound interval.
reviewed.banking_ledger: Traced loan40 at A, interbank funding15 from B before payment40, central-bank secured advance15 and repayment of the interbank debt. Reconciled each institution at every step, matching reserve and loan counterparts and keeping pledged collateral on the borrower’s books. Consolidating banks removes interbank claims; adding the central bank also removes reserves and its advance, while government securities/public deposits/equity remain under the stated boundary. Origination raises deposits without reserves, interbank operations redistribute reserves, and the central-bank advance creates reserves without equity. Every alternative branch is explicitly noncumulative.
reviewed.repayment_losses_and_purchases: Distinguished principal repayment from interest income; cross-bank principal repayment reduces deposits, whereas a recognized loan-value loss reduces equity without canceling deposits. Bank write-down is not automatically legal forgiveness. Currency conversion preserves the specified M/H totals. Outright purchases from a bank versus nonbank have different deposit counterparts, with unchanged immediate equity/net worth at the stipulated values. Additional borrowing is not a capital repair; new paid-in equity differs from secondary share trading. No whole-economy net-wealth or GDP increment is inferred from internal claims.
reviewed.capital_liquidity_constraints: Defined a synthetic risk-weight-one loan/equity inequality and separate reserve buffer/funding cap; explicitly did not claim a complete actual regulatory framework. Derived the global feasible extra-loan interval under stated full-outflow conditions, not a bank profit optimum. Calculated the post-loan capital headroom and the loss-induced existing-capital violation. Positive book equity is not sufficient capital compliance and may not imply economic solvency. Derived exact recapitalization minima and checked cross-bank subscription entries; sufficient capital alone does not guarantee settlement or additional eligible collateral.
reviewed.operating_model: Specified eligible reserve remuneration and a lending facility, rate ordering, positive gross rates, comparable risk/maturity, access/collateral and absence of intermediary frictions. Additional cash/storage outside options require revisiting the stipulated demand schedule, especially for negative rates. Solved all branches of a continuous piecewise reserve-demand law with a minimum necessary facility-supply convention. Proved the floor/ceiling and monotonicity conditions, retained the distinction between base reserves and total reserves after facility use, and covered the collapsed corridor/inactive ceiling. At equal administered rates, the common rate alone does not select a unique amount of costless extra borrowing/redepositing; the minimum-supply convention does. Limited collateral access deliberately breaks the original ceiling condition, and nonbank ineligibility can weaken the floor.
reviewed.transmission: Derived realized real gross returns and computed an exact uncertain-inflation counterexample to a ratio of means. Labeled arithmetic expected-real-rate subtraction as a small-rate approximation and noted the joint marginal-utility/return issue for risky Euler equations. Derived the fixed-payoff bond price sensitivity conditional on required yield. Distinguished current short rate from all-maturity yields and discussed news, expectations, resetting contracts, income/credit/collateral channels and endogenous policy timing. The exact finite default/recovery model obtains the minimum break-even loan quote by a monotone expected-cash-flow inequality, treats p=1 separately and does not imply a borrower or feasible positive lending quantity at every quote.
reviewed.examples_exercises_and_retention: Four complete original worked cases and eight full ordered solutions, covering interior/corner inference, partly retained deposits, principal versus credit loss, two asset-purchase counterparties, equity repair, facility access, exact real-return/bond/loan-rate arithmetic and a policy-causation critique. Recomputed every deterministic value independently. The open critique states evaluation criteria, alternative mechanisms, counterfactual requirements and limits rather than a preferred policy answer. Teach-back and fresh delayed check have complete answers. Current source text contains 7148 parser-counted words; scope is substantive rather than a summary.
reviewed.sources: Actually retrieved and inspected the official BoE2014 money-creation PDF, the full FOMC January30,2019 statement, the Fed July1,2020 implementation note and the ECB transmission-method page. Four source proposals record exact passage scope and historical/current distinctions. No actual current framework or rate is inferred from the historical documents, and no empirical results or source figures/exercises are reproduced. The synthetic demand, reserve schedule, bank haircut/capital rule and credit-risk model are independently specified, not attributed as estimated official equations.
reviewed.reproducible_asset: Original standard-library exact-fraction ledger exposes quiet benchmark output, six sequential snapshots and seven independently restarted branches. It validates institutional balances, account/chart membership, nonnegative fixture balances and matching reserve/interbank/advance counterparties before accepting a fresh journal copy. Failed postings leave the original unchanged. README fixes units, excluded accounts, collateral ownership, stage ordering, branch resets and limited purpose; all exact output fractions are ordinary JSON strings. It is deliberately a fixed teaching fixture, not a general bank-data API.

limitations: Internal author/root review is not independent human academic certification or empirical validation.
Exact references, finite grids and parser checks supplement full prose/proof review; they cannot establish an empirical causal effect or certify every possible model extension.
The balance-sheet fixture omits complete nonbank/government books, vault cash, cross-border positions, taxes, interest accruals and other institutions; it uses declared consolidation boundaries.

The capital rule, collateral haircut, reserve-demand shape, facility minimum-supply selection, quadratic benefit and fixed default probabilities are bounded teaching assumptions, not a current regulatory or operational description.
Source inspection is limited to recorded methods/passages; no whole-course, complete-country framework or current-policy certification is claimed.
The policy-evidence exercise is evaluated by explicit reasoning criteria, not numerical assertions.
